examples.en: She likes to bathe the baby in warm water.
examples.zh: 她喜欢用温水给宝宝洗澡。

examples.en: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.
examples.zh: 这两姐妹之间有着很强的相似之处。

examples.en: Quick action helped us avert a serious accident.
examples.zh: 迅速的行动帮助我们避免了一场严重的事故。

examples.en: The dentist found a small cavity in my tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医在我的牙齿里发现了一个小蛀洞。

examples.en: The word "and" is a common conjunction in English.
examples.zh: “and”这个词是英语中常见的连接词。

examples.en: The police decided to detain him for questioning.
examples.zh: 警方决定扣留他进行问话。

examples.en: The children love playing outdoors on sunny days.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在晴天到户外玩耍。

examples.en: The whole world condemned the genocide of innocent people.
examples.zh: 全世界都谴责对无辜民众的种族灭绝。

examples.en: After the long run, I crave a cold drink.
examples.zh: 长跑之后，我非常渴望来一杯冷饮。

examples.en: This new invention may redefine how we travel.
examples.zh: 这项新发明可能会重新定义我们的出行方式。

examples.en: As a novice, she made many small mistakes.
examples.zh: 作为一个新手，她犯了许多小错误。

examples.en: She finished tenth in the swimming race.
examples.zh: 她在游泳比赛中获得了第十名。

examples.en: The flood had a catastrophic effect on the village.
examples.zh: 这场洪水对村庄造成了灾难性的影响。

examples.en: She gave me a kind compliment about my dress.
examples.zh: 她友善地称赞了我的裙子。

examples.en: These two problems are completely unrelated to each other.
examples.zh: 这两个问题彼此之间毫无关联。

examples.en: The architect showed us the blueprint for the house.
examples.zh: 建筑师给我们看了这栋房子的设计图。

examples.en: We can see a clear progression in his English skills.
examples.zh: 我们能看到他的英语水平有明显的进步。

examples.en: The students made a short animation for the class.
examples.zh: 学生们为这堂课制作了一段简短的动画。

examples.en: A pedestrian should always cross at the green light.
examples.zh: 行人应该始终在绿灯时过马路。

examples.en: The museum displays a famous nude by a great painter.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一位伟大画家的著名裸体画。

examples.en: There was a sticky residue left at the bottom.
examples.zh: 底部留下了一层粘稠的残渣。

examples.en: He cried out in agony after breaking his leg.
examples.zh: 他摔断腿后痛苦地大叫起来。

examples.en: Could you shorten this essay by one page?
examples.zh: 你能把这篇文章缩短一页吗？

examples.en: The two top candidates will meet in a runoff.
examples.zh: 两位领先的候选人将进行决选。

examples.en: These rules are applicable to all the students here.
examples.zh: 这些规则适用于这里所有的学生。

examples.en: The team handled the problem quickly and professionally.
examples.zh: 团队迅速而专业地处理了这个问题。

examples.en: It took time to accustom myself to the cold weather.
examples.zh: 我花了些时间才让自己适应寒冷的天气。

examples.en: A good nurse shows empathy toward her patients.
examples.zh: 一位好护士会对她的病人表现出同情和共鸣。

examples.en: His health began to deteriorate after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病之后，他的健康开始恶化。

examples.en: The two cars almost collide at the busy corner.
examples.zh: 两辆车在繁忙的拐角处差点相撞。

examples.en: A park ranger told us not to feed the bears.
examples.zh: 一名护林员告诉我们不要喂熊。

examples.en: Farmers reap the wheat in late summer.
examples.zh: 农民们在夏末收割小麦。

examples.en: Your plan sounds feasible and not too expensive.
examples.zh: 你的计划听起来可行，而且花费不太高。

examples.en: Her mastery of English impressed all the teachers.
examples.zh: 她对英语的精通让所有老师都印象深刻。

examples.en: The manager issued a new directive about office hours.
examples.zh: 经理发布了一项关于办公时间的新指令。

examples.en: Regular exercise is a good preventive against many diseases.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼是预防许多疾病的好办法。

examples.en: He was too arrogant to listen to anyone's advice.
examples.zh: 他太傲慢了，根本听不进任何人的建议。

examples.en: It is important to be honest with oneself.
examples.zh: 对自己诚实是很重要的。

examples.en: I am dubious about his promise to help us.
examples.zh: 我对他答应帮助我们表示怀疑。

examples.en: The old building has a beautiful stone facade.
examples.zh: 这座老建筑有着漂亮的石头正面。

examples.en: The doctor said he needs a heart bypass soon.
examples.zh: 医生说他很快需要做心脏搭桥手术。

examples.en: She painted the walls a soft creamy white.
examples.zh: 她把墙刷成了柔和的奶油白色。

examples.en: Strong values underlie all of his daily decisions.
examples.zh: 坚定的价值观是他日常一切决定的基础。

examples.en: Shakespeare is the most famous English playwright in history.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚是历史上最著名的英国剧作家。

examples.en: She spent six years earning her PhD in biology.
examples.zh: 她花了六年时间攻读生物学博士学位。

examples.en: Warm air comes out of the vent near the floor.
examples.zh: 暖风从靠近地面的通风口吹出来。

examples.en: We watched the solar eclipse through special glasses.
examples.zh: 我们透过特制眼镜观看了日食。

examples.en: No one could foresee how the story would end.
examples.zh: 没有人能预见到这个故事会如何结束。

examples.en: Don't worry, this little snake is completely harmless.
examples.zh: 别担心，这条小蛇完全没有危害。

examples.en: The premier gave a speech about the new law.
examples.zh: 总理就这项新法律发表了讲话。

examples.en: The sailors faced great peril during the storm.
examples.zh: 水手们在暴风雨中面临着巨大的危险。

examples.en: Please put the extra notes inside a bracket.
examples.zh: 请把附加的注释放在括号里。

examples.en: Mix the flour and water into a thick paste.
examples.zh: 把面粉和水搅拌成浓稠的糊状物。

examples.en: She bought a new white bra at the store.
examples.zh: 她在商店里买了一件新的白色文胸。

examples.en: He got a dark bruise after hitting the table.
examples.zh: 撞到桌子后，他身上出现了一块青紫的瘀伤。

examples.en: The children wade through the shallow river happily.
examples.zh: 孩子们高兴地蹚过浅浅的河水。

examples.en: This farm raises poultry such as chickens and ducks.
examples.zh: 这家农场饲养鸡和鸭等家禽。

examples.en: The queen's reign lasted for forty years.
examples.zh: 女王的统治持续了四十年。

examples.en: The teacher asked me to rewrite the whole paragraph.
examples.zh: 老师让我把整段重写一遍。

examples.en: Reading books gives me great enjoyment every evening.
examples.zh: 每天晚上读书给我带来极大的乐趣。

examples.en: The Japanese automaker plans to build electric cars.
examples.zh: 这家日本汽车制造商计划生产电动汽车。

examples.en: She rightly pointed out the mistake in my report.
examples.zh: 她正确地指出了我报告中的错误。

examples.en: We laughed a lot while watching the funny sitcom.
examples.zh: 看那部搞笑的情景喜剧时我们笑了很多。

examples.en: Many people sang patriotic songs on the holiday.
examples.zh: 许多人在这个节日里唱起了爱国歌曲。

examples.en: I had some cheese on a thin salty cracker.
examples.zh: 我在一块薄薄的咸饼干上放了些奶酪。

examples.en: The president faced impeachment for his serious mistakes.
examples.zh: 总统因严重错误而面临弹劾。

examples.en: The advertiser paid a lot to show this ad.
examples.zh: 这家广告客户花了很多钱来播放这则广告。

examples.en: A long procession moved slowly down the main street.
examples.zh: 一支长长的队伍沿着主街缓缓行进。

examples.en: She studies genetics to understand how traits pass on.
examples.zh: 她研究遗传学，以了解特征是如何遗传的。

examples.en: We should not perpetuate such an unfair old habit.
examples.zh: 我们不应让这种不公平的旧习惯延续下去。

examples.en: People suffered greatly under the cruel dictatorship.
examples.zh: 人们在残酷的独裁统治下受尽了苦难。

examples.en: Gosh, I never expected to win the first prize!
examples.zh: 天哪，我从没想到自己会得一等奖！

examples.en: Years of hard study finally brought a big payoff.
examples.zh: 多年的刻苦学习终于带来了丰厚的回报。

examples.en: The survey asked both gay and heterosexual people.
examples.zh: 这项调查同时询问了同性恋者和异性恋者。

examples.en: She gave a low moan when her head ached.
examples.zh: 头疼时她发出了一声低低的呻吟。

examples.en: Taking the medicine should lessen your pain.
examples.zh: 服用这种药应该能减轻你的疼痛。

examples.en: Short jackets are very fashionable this spring.
examples.zh: 短款外套在今年春天非常流行。

examples.en: The book describes the conquest of the ancient city.
examples.zh: 这本书描述了对那座古城的征服。

examples.en: Life expectancy in this country keeps rising every year.
examples.zh: 这个国家的预期寿命每年都在持续上升。

examples.en: We enjoyed a delicious Lebanese meal last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们享用了一顿美味的黎巴嫩餐。

examples.en: The bill was passed after a long parliamentary debate.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的议会辩论后，这项法案获得通过。

examples.en: Her family has been Methodist for many generations.
examples.zh: 她家好几代人都是卫理公会教徒。

examples.en: He put the important papers into his briefcase.
examples.zh: 他把重要文件放进了自己的公事包里。

examples.en: The town is infamous for its terrible traffic.
examples.zh: 这座小镇因糟糕的交通而声名狼藉。

examples.en: The study used a careful quantitative analysis of the data.
examples.zh: 这项研究对数据进行了细致的定量分析。

examples.en: The two countries were on the brink of war.
examples.zh: 这两个国家处在战争的边缘。

examples.en: He saves part of every paycheck for the future.
examples.zh: 他把每次薪水的一部分存起来以备将来之需。

examples.en: The orchestra played a beautiful symphony last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚乐团演奏了一首优美的交响曲。

examples.en: This plum is sweet, juicy, and perfectly ripe.
examples.zh: 这个李子又甜又多汁，熟得恰到好处。

examples.en: Climbing high mountains is inherently dangerous.
examples.zh: 攀登高山本质上是危险的。

examples.en: They keep their best wine down in the cellar.
examples.zh: 他们把最好的酒存放在地窖里。

examples.en: After the breakup, she felt sad for weeks.
examples.zh: 分手之后，她难过了好几个星期。

examples.en: The floodwaters slowly began to recede after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨停后，洪水开始慢慢退去。

examples.en: Wild flowers abound in these green hills in spring.
examples.zh: 春天里，这些青翠的山丘上野花遍地。

examples.en: My parents give me a small weekly allowance.
examples.zh: 我父母每周给我一点零花钱。

examples.en: Scientists found a clear linkage between smoking and illness.
examples.zh: 科学家发现吸烟与疾病之间有明显的关联。

examples.en: Mom is cooking a big roast for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 妈妈正在为周日晚餐做一大块烤肉。

examples.en: The painting is a vivid depiction of country life.
examples.zh: 这幅画生动地描绘了乡村生活。

examples.en: House prices began to plummet after the bad news.
examples.zh: 坏消息传出后，房价开始直线下跌。

examples.en: The people suffered years of harsh political repression.
examples.zh: 人民遭受了多年残酷的政治压迫。

examples.en: His lust for money made him forget his friends.
examples.zh: 他对金钱的贪欲使他忘记了朋友。

examples.en: This painting is widely seen as the artist's masterpiece.
examples.zh: 这幅画被普遍视为这位艺术家的杰作。

examples.en: Months of practice will culminate in tonight's big show.
examples.zh: 数月的练习将在今晚的大型演出中达到高潮。

examples.en: The children got lost in the garden maze.
examples.zh: 孩子们在花园的迷宫里迷路了。

examples.en: The high ridge forms the watershed between two rivers.
examples.zh: 这道高高的山脊构成了两条河流之间的分水岭。

examples.en: Losing in front of everyone was a deep humiliation.
examples.zh: 当着众人的面输掉是一种深深的耻辱。

examples.en: Good drainage keeps the field from flooding in rain.
examples.zh: 良好的排水能让这块田在下雨时不被淹。

examples.en: The new evidence may implicate two more people.
examples.zh: 新的证据可能会牵连到另外两个人。

examples.en: Food was very scarce during wartime in that country.
examples.zh: 战时那个国家的食物非常匮乏。

examples.en: She works for a large multinational company in the city.
examples.zh: 她在城里一家大型跨国公司工作。

examples.en: The museum displays beautiful old Navajo blankets.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了精美的古老纳瓦霍毛毯。

examples.en: Surviving the long, cold winter was a real ordeal.
examples.zh: 熬过漫长寒冷的冬天是一场真正的煎熬。

examples.en: The machine needs periodic checks to work well.
examples.zh: 这台机器需要定期检查才能正常运转。

examples.en: Our team scored three runs in the last inning.
examples.zh: 我们队在最后一局得了三分。

examples.en: She took a quick snapshot of the sunset.
examples.zh: 她迅速拍了一张日落的快照。

examples.en: The little girl seems to adore her grandfather.
examples.zh: 这个小女孩似乎非常爱慕她的祖父。

examples.en: Give me the literal meaning of this French word.
examples.zh: 请告诉我这个法语单词的字面意思。

examples.en: Be careful, the floor is wet and slippery.
examples.zh: 小心，地板又湿又滑。

examples.en: We had a splendid view from the mountain top.
examples.zh: 我们从山顶望见了壮丽的景色。

examples.en: The window has a fine mesh to keep out flies.
examples.zh: 窗户上装有细密的网纱，用来挡苍蝇。

examples.en: In the dark, I could barely discern her face.
examples.zh: 在黑暗中，我几乎看不清她的脸。

examples.en: The referee called a foul against the home team.
examples.zh: 裁判判罚主队犯规。

examples.en: He politely asked the old lady to sit down.
examples.zh: 他礼貌地请那位老太太坐下。

examples.en: The charity will solicit donations from local shops.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构将向当地商店募捐。

examples.en: I have a dull ache in my lower back.
examples.zh: 我的下背部有一种隐隐的疼痛。

examples.en: Please slice the bread thinly for the sandwiches.
examples.zh: 请把面包切薄一些，用来做三明治。

examples.en: She has a cold and speaks in a nasal voice.
examples.zh: 她感冒了，说话带着鼻音。

examples.en: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
examples.zh: 我们暂定了下周见面的计划。

examples.en: He was so tired he began to stagger home.
examples.zh: 他累得开始踉踉跄跄地往家走。

examples.en: She gave me a gentle nudge to wake me up.
examples.zh: 她轻轻推了我一下，把我叫醒。

examples.en: The magician seemed to conjure a rabbit from nowhere.
examples.zh: 魔术师似乎凭空变出了一只兔子。

examples.en: Scientists calculated the trajectory of the small rocket.
examples.zh: 科学家们计算出了这枚小火箭的轨道。

examples.en: A large parcel arrived for you this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一个大包裹寄给你。

examples.en: His first attempt to pass the test was unsuccessful.
examples.zh: 他第一次想通过考试的尝试没有成功。

examples.en: The wicked witch tricked the two young children.
examples.zh: 那个邪恶的女巫骗了两个小孩子。

examples.en: This soup is too spicy for the little kids.
examples.zh: 这汤对小孩子来说太辣了。

examples.en: Trade encourages friendly intercourse between different countries.
examples.zh: 贸易促进了不同国家之间的友好往来。

examples.en: A small golden ornament hung on the tree.
examples.zh: 一个小小的金色装饰品挂在树上。

examples.en: From the observatory we watched the bright stars.
examples.zh: 我们在天文台观看了明亮的星星。

examples.en: Running a marathon requires great strength and endurance.
examples.zh: 跑马拉松需要极强的力量和耐力。

examples.en: Tight rules can constrain a child's natural curiosity.
examples.zh: 严苛的规定可能会限制孩子天生的好奇心。

examples.en: Add a pinch of salt to the boiling soup.
examples.zh: 往沸腾的汤里加一小撮盐。

examples.en: The students left the room in an orderly line.
examples.zh: 学生们排成整齐的一列离开了房间。

examples.en: He left the door open intentionally for the cat.
examples.zh: 他故意把门开着，好让猫进来。

examples.en: The children ran outside to play during recess.
examples.zh: 课间休息时孩子们跑到外面去玩。

examples.en: She writes a travel blog about her many trips.
examples.zh: 她写一个旅行博客，记录自己的多次旅行。

examples.en: There was a slow buildup of dust on the shelf.
examples.zh: 架子上慢慢积起了一层灰尘。

examples.en: Big waves of surf crashed onto the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 大浪拍打在沙滩上。

examples.en: The form asked for my name and my nationality.
examples.zh: 这张表格要求填写我的姓名和国籍。

examples.en: We sat in the warm sunshine all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午我们都坐在温暖的阳光下。

examples.en: A single flake of snow landed on her nose.
examples.zh: 一片雪花落在了她的鼻子上。

examples.en: He learned many culinary skills at cooking school.
examples.zh: 他在烹饪学校学到了许多厨艺。

examples.en: His brother became an alcoholic and lost his job.
examples.zh: 他哥哥成了酒鬼，丢了工作。

examples.en: The expert gave a fair appraisal of the painting.
examples.zh: 专家对这幅画做出了公正的估价。

examples.en: Please reconsider your decision before it is too late.
examples.zh: 请在为时已晚之前重新考虑你的决定。

examples.en: The newborn baby slept quietly in her arms.
examples.zh: 新生的婴儿在她怀里安静地睡着。

examples.en: He told us the long saga of his journey.
examples.zh: 他给我们讲述了他旅程的漫长传奇故事。

examples.en: Their team won the opener of the new season.
examples.zh: 他们队赢得了新赛季的揭幕战。

examples.en: The brave explorer crossed the icy land alone.
examples.zh: 这位勇敢的探险家独自穿越了冰封的土地。

examples.en: Pollution causes serious degradation of the local rivers.
examples.zh: 污染导致当地河流严重退化。

examples.en: An offshore wind pushed the small boats out.
examples.zh: 一阵离岸风把小船吹向了海面。

examples.en: The team showed clear superiority over their rivals.
examples.zh: 这支队伍展现出对对手明显的优势。

examples.en: Rainforests are home to amazing biodiversity.
examples.zh: 雨林是惊人的生物多样性的家园。

examples.en: She painted each fingernail a bright pink.
examples.zh: 她把每个指甲都涂成了亮粉色。

examples.en: The tank holds about two cubic meters of water.
examples.zh: 这个水箱大约能装两立方米的水。

examples.en: He just wants to bum around all summer long.
examples.zh: 他只想整个夏天都游手好闲地混日子。

examples.en: The family sought asylum in a safer country.
examples.zh: 这家人在一个更安全的国家寻求庇护。

examples.en: Her kindness and patience exemplify a good teacher.
examples.zh: 她的善良和耐心体现了一位好老师的品质。

examples.en: Press the right pedal to make the car go.
examples.zh: 踩右边的踏板让车前进。

examples.en: The angry cat gave a loud hiss at the dog.
examples.zh: 愤怒的猫对着狗发出响亮的嘶嘶声。

examples.en: He seemed incapable of telling a simple lie.
examples.zh: 他似乎连一个简单的谎都不会撒。

examples.en: Many habits are formed long before adulthood.
examples.zh: 许多习惯在成年之前很久就已养成。

examples.en: The doctor performed an autopsy to find the cause.
examples.zh: 医生进行了尸检以查明死因。

examples.en: A gigantic ship slowly entered the busy harbor.
examples.zh: 一艘巨大的轮船缓缓驶入繁忙的港口。

examples.en: The band has a wide repertoire of old songs.
examples.zh: 这支乐队拥有大量的老歌曲目。

examples.en: The teacher will scrutinize every answer very carefully.
examples.zh: 老师会非常仔细地审查每一个答案。

examples.en: The actors rehearse the play every evening this week.
examples.zh: 本周演员们每天晚上都排练这出戏。

examples.en: Please shuffle the cards well before we start.
examples.zh: 开始之前请把牌好好洗一洗。

examples.en: The bad result made us rethink our whole plan.
examples.zh: 糟糕的结果让我们重新思考整个计划。

examples.en: Childhood events can shape a person's whole psyche.
examples.zh: 童年的经历可以塑造一个人的整个心灵。

examples.en: Some residual fear stayed with him for years.
examples.zh: 一些残留的恐惧伴随了他许多年。

examples.en: They turned the old loft into a cozy bedroom.
examples.zh: 他们把旧阁楼改成了一间舒适的卧室。

examples.en: The apples were packed in a large wooden crate.
examples.zh: 苹果被装在一个大木箱里。

examples.en: Uranium is used as fuel in nuclear power plants.
examples.zh: 铀被用作核电站的燃料。

examples.en: The two teams competed fiercely until the very end.
examples.zh: 两支队伍一直激烈竞争到最后一刻。

examples.en: Many workers worried about a possible layoff.
examples.zh: 许多工人担心可能会被裁员。

examples.en: A small green lizard sat on the warm rock.
examples.zh: 一只绿色的小蜥蜴趴在温暖的岩石上。

examples.en: The doctor explained how the penis works in class.
examples.zh: 医生在课上讲解了阴茎的功能。

examples.en: Tourists marvel at the size of the old castle.
examples.zh: 游客们惊叹于这座古堡的宏大规模。

examples.en: The tailor made a perfect suit for my father.
examples.zh: 裁缝为我父亲做了一套完美的西装。

examples.en: She drinks her tea from a small ceramic cup.
examples.zh: 她用一个小小的陶瓷杯喝茶。

examples.en: A beautiful green gem shone on her ring.
examples.zh: 她的戒指上有一颗美丽的绿色宝石在闪耀。

examples.en: The strong wind shook the trees violently all night.
examples.zh: 整夜的大风猛烈地摇撼着树木。

examples.en: She is a compassionate nurse who cares for everyone.
examples.zh: 她是一位富有同情心的护士，关心每一个人。

examples.en: A few flowers will brighten the whole room.
examples.zh: 几朵花会让整个房间变得明亮起来。

examples.en: The horse began to champ on its bit nervously.
examples.zh: 那匹马紧张地大声咬着嚼子。

examples.en: The leaders will convene to discuss the new plan.
examples.zh: 领导人将开会讨论这项新计划。

examples.en: There are nineteen students in our small class.
examples.zh: 我们这个小班里有十九名学生。

examples.en: She noticed a small wrinkle near her eyes.
examples.zh: 她注意到眼角有一条小皱纹。

examples.en: The psychic claimed she could see the future.
examples.zh: 那位灵媒声称她能预见未来。
